dialogues.speaker: Berezova
dialogues.text: Come on, since the train will still be running for a while, let's make good use of the time and review. Now then, answer the question I asked you last time.

dialogues.speaker: Berezova
dialogues.text: For Volkodlak customers, where exactly does the "hair" begin, and where does it become "facial hair"?

dialogues.speaker: Berezova
dialogues.text: This is a crucial question! It determines whether we should use conditioner or facial cleanser during grooming. Mix them up, and our customers' fur could lose its shine!

dialogues.speaker: Chelnova
dialogues.text: L—Let me think... I remember you saying the brow ridge should be the dividing line, Ma'am...

dialogues.speaker: Berezova
dialogues.text: Incorrect. There is no standard answer. Each customer must be judged individually. Even Volkodlak of the same kind can have different fur patterns.

dialogues.speaker: Chelnova
dialogues.text: ...Then what was the point of asking— Ahem. I—I mean, I've got it! I'll be sure to remember that, Ma'am!
